import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int N, T;
    static char[][] B = new char[12][12];
    static char[][] B1 = new char[12][12];
    static char[][] B2 = new char[12][12];

    static int[][] D1 = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] D2 = new int[12][12];

    static int[] dr = {-1, 0, 0, 1};
    static int[] dc = {0, -1, 1, 0};

    static class Pos {
        int row, col;
        Pos(int _row, int _col) {
            this.row = _row;
            this.col = _col;
        }
    }

    static void bfs1(Pos src) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(D1[i], -1);
        }
        D1[src.row][src.col] = 0;
        Queue<Pos> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(src);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Pos cur = q.poll();
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nr = cur.row + dr[k];
                int nc = cur.col + dc[k];
                if (nr < 0 || nr >= N + 2 || nc < 0 || nc >= N + 2) continue;
                if (B[nr][nc] != '.') continue;
                if (D1[nr][nc] < 0) {
                    D1[nr][nc] = D1[cur.row][cur.col] + 1;
                    q.offer(new Pos(nr, nc));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void bfs2(Pos src) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(D2[i], -1);
        }
        D2[src.row][src.col] = 0;
        Queue<Pos> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(src);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Pos cur = q.poll();
            if (D1[cur.row][cur.col] >= 0 && D2[cur.row][cur.col] >= D1[cur.row][cur.col]) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nr = cur.row + dr[k];
                int nc = cur.col + dc[k];
                if (nr < 0 || nr >= N + 2 || nc < 0 || nc >= N + 2) continue;
                if (B[nr][nc] != '.') continue;
                if (D2[nr][nc] < 0) {
                    if (D1[nr][nc] >= 0 && D1[nr][nc] < D2[cur.row][cur.col] + 1) continue;
                    D2[nr][nc] = D2[cur.row][cur.col] + 1;
                    q.offer(new Pos(nr, nc));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static class MaxFlow {
        int N;
        int[] bfs_par, bfs_D;
        int[][] cap, flow;

        MaxFlow(int _N) {
            N = _N;
            cap = new int[N][N];
            flow = new int[N][N];
        }

        void add_edge(int u, int v, int _cap) {
            cap[u][v] += _cap;
        }

        int augmenting_path_bfs(int src, int dst, List<Integer> path, int mincap) {
            bfs_par = new int[N];
            bfs_D = new int[N];
            Arrays.fill(bfs_par, -1);
            Arrays.fill(bfs_D, -1);
            bfs_D[src] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(src);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int cur = q.poll();
                if (cur == dst) {
                    int cfp = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                    path.clear();
                    for (int v = dst; v >= 0; v = bfs_par[v]) {
                        path.add(v);
                        if (bfs_par[v] >= 0) {
                            cfp = Math.min(cfp, cap[bfs_par[v]][v] - flow[bfs_par[v]][v]);
                        }
                    }
                    Collections.reverse(path);
                    return cfp;
                }
                for (int v = 0; v < N; v++) {
                    if (bfs_D[v] < 0 && cap[cur][v] - flow[cur][v] > mincap) {
                        bfs_D[v] = bfs_D[cur] + 1;
                        bfs_par[v] = cur;
                        q.offer(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        int dinic(int s, int t) {
            int res = 0;
            while (true) {
                List<Integer> path = new ArrayList<>();
                int cfp = augmenting_path_bfs(s, t, path, 0);
                if (path.isEmpty()) break;
                for (int i = 0; i < path.size() - 1; i++) {
                    int u = path.get(i);
                    int v = path.get(i + 1);
                    flow[u][v] += cfp;
                    flow[v][u] -= cfp;
                }
                res += cfp;
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        T = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(B1[i], '#');
            Arrays.fill(B2[i], '#');
            Arrays.fill(B[i], '#');
        }

        for (int r = 1; r <= N; r++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            B1[r] = ("#" + line + "#").toCharArray();
        }
        for (int r = 1; r <= N; r++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            B2[r] = ("#" + line + "#").toCharArray();
        }

        List<Pos> scientists = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Pos> capsules = new ArrayList<>();
        Pos z = new Pos(0, 0);

        for (int r = 1; r <= N; r++) {
            for (int c = 1; c <= N; c++) {
                char ch1 = B1[r][c];
                if (Character.isDigit(ch1) && ch1 > '0') {
                    scientists.add(new Pos(r, c));
                    B[r][c] = '.';
                } else if (ch1 == 'Z') {
                    z = new Pos(r, c);
                    B[r][c] = '.';
                }
                char ch2 = B2[r][c];
                if (Character.isDigit(ch2) && ch2 > '0') {
                    capsules.add(new Pos(r, c));
                }
            }
        }

        bfs1(z);

        int SRC = 0;
        int SINK = scientists.size() + capsules.size() + 1;

        MaxFlow mf = new MaxFlow(SINK + 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < scientists.size(); i++) {
            Pos s = scientists.get(i);
            mf.add_edge(SRC, i + 1, B1[s.row][s.col] - '0');
        }
        for (int j = 0; j < capsules.size(); j++) {
            Pos c = capsules.get(j);
            mf.add_edge(scientists.size() + j + 1, SINK, B2[c.row][c.col] - '0');
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < scientists.size(); i++) {
            Pos s = scientists.get(i);
            bfs2(s);
            for (int j = 0; j < capsules.size(); j++) {
                Pos c = capsules.get(j);
                if (D2[c.row][c.col] >= 0 && D2[c.row][c.col] <= T) {
                    mf.add_edge(i + 1, scientists.size() + j + 1, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                }
            }
        }

        int res = mf.dinic(SRC, SINK);
        System.out.println(res);
    }
}
